threadObservation.meaning: Observed API reporting, not measured worker count or a demonstrated correctness cause

whyNominalOracleQualificationIsLower.finding: All9 rejected oracle components already have fewer than180 clean7px, center-visible source seeds. The locked oracle eligibility mask therefore makes qualification impossible before testing pose residuals, cells, span or common scale. This is a necessary support-ceiling explanation, not a posthoc redefinition of the denominator.
whyNominalOracleQualificationIsLower.whyMeasuredCanQualify: The measured frozen gate requires actual FB/NCC quality, but does not require each7px patch to contain one material surface. The oracle arm intentionally requires that additional finite-footprint eligibility. Many excluded mixed-material patches still match correctly, especially identical stationary images. The two arms do not have equal positive-evidence masks; a higher measured qualification count does not establish better geometry than the oracle.
whyNominalOracleQualificationIsLower.borderPartitionAuthority: Derived only from retained source/target pixel coordinates and stored clean7 flags. A visible point with failed clean7 but an entirely in-bounds bilinear lattice must fail the stored material-ID condition. No material-ray oracle was rerun.

poseArithmeticEvidence.interpretation: The authored endpoints agree with supplied-pose epiline/sign arithmetic to numerical precision. These controls do not support a nominal pose-convention bug. Exact oracle agreement does not establish physical Boreas calibration or synchronization accuracy.

whyNominalOracleQualificationIsLower.additionalRepresentationLimit: The accelerating cases split eligible points into R-low-impact and E-observed-parallax populations114/44 and60/109. Neither branch alone reaches70% of256. This is an additional gate-model limitation; no union arm was measured or promoted, and no existing criterion was changed.

actualRgbCorrespondenceEvidence.countingNote: An accepted wrong visible endpoint counts as both a false correspondence and a missed correct correspondence. These are not a single mutually exclusive binary accuracy table.

nominalQualifiedCameraSelectedPointOutli.meaning: Background camera qualification is a robust population test, not a certificate for every chosen correspondence

fastReveal.finding: The two fast-reveal cases account for339/505 missed correct correspondences. Most first vetoes are LK status or FB cycle, not NCC alone. Large authored displacement is an observed stress factor, but texture resampling, boundary/occlusion and LK capture range remain confounded; this does not isolate one implementation defect.

negativeControlInterpretation.hardClock40ms: Each offset has12pairs times2components, so24cases per offset and48total across minus40ms/plus40ms. All are rejected by the unchanged timestamp contract; this is a contract check, not learned synchronization diagnosis.
negativeControlInterpretation.withinContract10ms: Known stationary/lateral/body-twist timing invariants are explicitly not-identifiable. The only nominal-qualified, non-invariant holdout changing-direction case remains compatible at minus10ms and is rejected at plus10ms. This is one controlled sensitivity observation, not a calibrated time-offset detector or a chosen correction.
negativeControlInterpretation.calibration: The nominal-qualified non-invariant holdout changing-direction case also remains compatible under each fixed fx-times1.05 and cx-plus8 injection. Known stationary/lateral invariants remain separate. No correction can be selected from these compatibility counts.
negativeControlInterpretation.alongEpilineControls: All10 evaluated along-epiline wrong-endpoint arms have fewer than180 eligible wrong points, so0 qualified arms cannot show that epiline-only ambiguity is resolved. In the two nominal-qualified epipolar cases, fixed8px shifts reduce eligible populations184 to179 and183 to178 because of out-of-view endpoints. Those179/178 points still satisfy the stored E agreement. Rejection is a support ceiling, not successful endpoint-error discrimination.
negativeControlInterpretation.perpendicularControls: In the same two nominal-qualified epipolar cases,181 wrong endpoints remain eligible but R/E agreement becomes0, giving a stronger conditional falsification of perpendicular errors. The stationary arms remain explicitly epipolar-unobservable.

hpatchesReferenceBottleneck.authority: External estimated homography only, not exact physical pixel truth, independent depth/pose or occlusion gold

iLondonbridge.interpretation: The identity-reference disagreement is shared by current native LK and two previously completed matching methods, including the resized working-domain run. This makes the external-H precision/alignment an important unresolved reference limitation. Agreement among matchers does not prove the physical endpoint or that H is wrong. The frozen222 conditional wrong labels are retained; they must not be advertised as222 proven physical mismatches.
iLondonbridge.notDone: No homography was fitted, offset searched, identity H replaced, threshold enlarged or matcher rerun.

vAbstract.interpretation: The same LK setup has major missed-match counts under the estimated viewpoint-change reference, but the two HPatches samples cannot establish real-video generalization.

supported: Exact controlled geometry separates nominal pose algebra from strict source-support eligibility: all9 oracle failures are support-ceiling limited.
RGB-only FB/NCC does accept some incorrect or invisible correspondences; camera qualification is not a per-point proof.
Fast-reveal correspondence failure is measured and concentrated in LK status/cycle stages, with roughly94px median true displacement.
Timing/calibration compatibility has explicit non-identifiable cases; negative controls cannot be pooled into universal fault-detection accuracy.

disposition.nextConstraint: Do not turn the oracle mask ceiling into a threshold/denominator relaxation or call this a13FN fix. Any subsequent experiment must preserve this receipt, isolate one useful measured change and keep exact authored, estimated-H and real-traffic evidence separate.
